sloka: दीपयन्ती इव मे कामम् विविधा मुदिता द्विजाः ।श्यामाम् चन्द्र मुखीम् स्मृत्वा प्रियाम् पद्म निभ ईक्षणाम् ॥४-१-१००॥
transliteration: dīpayantī iva me kāmam vividhā muditā dvijāḥ ।śyāmām candra mukhīm smṛtvā priyām padma nibha īkṣaṇām ॥4-1-100॥

translations.english: Pampa, filled with swimming, kraunchas and frequented by big animals looks splendid. The joyous warbling of a variety of birds is highly exciting. They kindle my passion for my young, Moonfaced, lotus eyed beloved.
